description: Shared fixtures for Focus time occurrence math. The TypeScript implementation (lib/focus.ts) and the Dart port must both produce exactly these outputs.

conventions.timestamps: Instants are ISO-8601 UTC strings ending in Z with whole seconds. Compare as instants.
conventions.localDate: YYYY-MM-DD calendar key in the account timezone (user_settings.timezone).
conventions.startTime: Account-local wall-clock time "HH:MM:SS". weekdays are ISO: 1 = Monday .. 7 = Sunday.
conventions.dst: Spring-forward gap: a nonexistent wall time shifts forward by the gap (02:30 -> 03:30). Autumn fold: a repeated wall time uses the first instance (the earlier UTC instant).

groups.occurrenceStart: focusOccurrenceStart(localDate, startTime, timeZone) -> instant. Fields: localDate, startTime, timeZone, expected.
groups.nextOccurrences: nextFocusOccurrences(time, now, timeZone, count) -> list of {localDate, startsAt, endsAt}, ascending. Weekly dates on or after today's account-local date whose endsAt (= startsAt + budget_minutes) is strictly after now. An occurrence is listed while now < endsAt. Fields: time{weekdays,start_time,budget_minutes}, now, timeZone, count, expected.
groups.missed: isOccurrenceMissed(occurrence, plannedMinutes, now, timeZone) -> bool. True iff plannedMinutes is non-empty and now >= start + max(budgetMinutes, sum(plannedMinutes)) minutes. Use budgetMinutes 0 for one-off assignments. Fields: occurrence{localDate,startTime,budgetMinutes}, plannedMinutes, now, timeZone, expected.
groups.nextWeekdayAfter: nextWeekdayAfter(localDate, isoWeekday) -> YYYY-MM-DD, the first date strictly after localDate falling on isoWeekday (always 1..7 days later). Fields: localDate, isoWeekday, expected.

occurrenceStart.name: 2026-11-05T19:00:00-America/New_York
occurrenceStart.description: Normal EST evening (UTC-5) after the autumn change.

occurrenceStart.name: 2027-03-14T02:30:00-America/New_York
occurrenceStart.description: Spring-forward gap: 02:30 does not exist, shifts forward by the one hour gap to 03:30 EDT.

occurrenceStart.name: 2027-03-14T03:30:00-America/New_York
occurrenceStart.description: The first real time after the gap equals the shifted gap time.

occurrenceStart.name: 2026-11-01T01:30:00-America/New_York
occurrenceStart.description: Autumn fold: 01:30 occurs twice; first instance (EDT) wins.

occurrenceStart.name: 2026-11-01T02:30:00-America/New_York
occurrenceStart.description: After the fold: 02:30 is only EST (UTC-5).

occurrenceStart.name: 2027-04-04T02:30:00-Australia/Sydney
occurrenceStart.description: Southern hemisphere autumn fold (03:00 AEDT back to 02:00 AEST): first instance (AEDT).

nextOccurrences.name: thu-sat-month-boundary-and-dst-end
nextOccurrences.description: Thursday/Saturday 7 PM from a Wednesday: crosses Oct->Nov and the 2026-11-01 autumn DST change (EDT -4 then EST -5).

nextOccurrences.name: thu-sat-year-boundary
nextOccurrences.description: Thursday/Saturday 7 PM crossing the 2026->2027 year boundary in a non-US zone (GMT, no offset).

nextOccurrences.name: account-midnight-local-saturday
nextOccurrences.description: It is already Sunday in UTC but still Saturday evening in the account zone: the local Saturday 9 PM occurrence (01:00Z Sunday) is today and still upcoming.

nextOccurrences.name: account-midnight-past-budget-skips-today
nextOccurrences.description: Local date is Saturday 2026-10-17 20:30; the 9 AM Saturday occurrence already ended, so the list starts the following Saturday.

nextOccurrences.name: kolkata-local-date-ahead-of-utc
nextOccurrences.description: Non-DST zone UTC+5:30 where the account date (Mon 2026-10-19 00:15) is already ahead of the UTC date.

nextOccurrences.name: in-progress-still-listed
nextOccurrences.description: Thursday 19:20 local: the 7 PM occurrence (ends 23:30Z) is in progress and stays listed.

nextOccurrences.name: one-second-before-budget-end
nextOccurrences.description: One second before start + budget: the occurrence is still listed.

nextOccurrences.name: exactly-at-budget-end-drops
nextOccurrences.description: At exactly start + budget the occurrence is over and is no longer listed; the list begins on Saturday.

nextOccurrences.name: dst-spring-gap-shifts-forward
nextOccurrences.description: Sunday 2027-03-14 02:30 does not exist in New_York (02:00 jumps to 03:00): it shifts forward by the gap to 03:30 EDT = 07:30Z. The next week is a normal 02:30 EDT.

nextOccurrences.name: dst-autumn-fold-first-instance
nextOccurrences.description: Sunday 2026-11-01 01:30 happens twice in New_York; the first instance (EDT, 05:30Z) is used. The next week is a normal EST time.

nextOccurrences.name: southern-hemisphere-spring-gap
nextOccurrences.description: Sunday 2026-10-04 02:30 does not exist in Sydney (02:00 AEST -> 03:00 AEDT): shifts forward to 03:30 AEDT = 16:30Z the day before.

nextOccurrences.name: daily-late-evening-year-end
nextOccurrences.description: Every day 11:30 PM Pacific; now is 8:55 PM on 2026-12-30 local, so the first occurrence is that evening and the list rolls over the year.

nextOccurrences.name: count-zero-is-empty
nextOccurrences.description: Asking for zero occurrences returns an empty list.

missed.name: before-budget-end
missed.description: Budget 30, one 10-minute task: one second before 19:30 local is not missed.

missed.name: at-budget-end
missed.description: Exactly start + budget with planned work is missed.

missed.name: planned-exceeds-budget-not-yet
missed.description: Planned 25+35=60 min exceeds the 30 min budget, so the window runs to 20:00 local; at 19:45 it is not missed.

missed.name: planned-exceeds-budget-missed
missed.description: Same plan at exactly 20:00 local is missed.

missed.name: no-planned-work-never-missed
missed.description: An occurrence with no planned work is never missed, however old.

missed.name: one-off-uses-planned-minutes
missed.description: A one-off assignment (budget 0) is missed once its own planned minutes pass: 07:15 + 20 min.

missed.name: one-off-just-before
missed.description: Same one-off one second earlier is not missed.

missed.name: dst-gap-occurrence
missed.description: Gap-shifted start 03:30 EDT (07:30Z) + 30 min budget: 08:00Z is the boundary.

missed.name: future-occurrence-not-missed
missed.description: An occurrence that has not started is not missed.

nextWeekdayAfter.name: 2026-10-30-iso6
nextWeekdayAfter.description: From Friday the next Saturday is the following day.

nextWeekdayAfter.name: 2026-12-31-iso4
nextWeekdayAfter.description: Missed Thursday at year end: next Thursday is in the new year.

nextWeekdayAfter.name: 2026-10-31-iso7
nextWeekdayAfter.description: Saturday to the next Sunday is one day later.

nextWeekdayAfter.name: 2028-02-28-iso2
nextWeekdayAfter.description: Leap year: Monday 2028-02-28 to Tuesday is 2028-02-29.

nextWeekdayAfter.name: 2028-02-29-iso2
nextWeekdayAfter.description: Leap day Tuesday: next Tuesday is 2028-03-07.

nextWeekdayAfter.name: 2027-12-26-iso1
nextWeekdayAfter.description: Sunday to Monday across the year boundary week.

nextWeekdayAfter.name: 2026-11-01-iso7
nextWeekdayAfter.description: Sunday of the autumn DST change: next Sunday is +7 (calendar math, no timezone).
